scope: Verify that GTK2 repository RGB reference colors are translated to current KDE palette roles before the generated GTK2 RC is used.

repository_rc_template.role_derived_generation: R448 verified this template as the recorded baseline; the installed runtime adds the generated KDE-palette include.

method.execution: PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1; in-memory rc_colors generation plus focused unittest discovery; no temporary output files, installs, user-app restarts, or VM input.
method.blue_palette_note: The source template values coincide with the supplied blue scheme's roles; generated dark/yellow variants contain none of those source literals and are deterministic role-derived outputs.

result: The GTK2 generator replaces all four repository template RGB literals when translating dark and yellow palettes; the source colors are not retained as fixed final values in those generated RCs. Focused tests confirm palette-sensitive output and IconView role mapping. No static product color was introduced by this audit.
limits: This proves role translation in the GTK2 generator, not which scheme an already-running application has loaded.
This is not historical VUE pixel evidence and does not close R450's pending native hover, insensitive, held-direction or thumb-drag states.
No product files, installed profiles, apps, or VM were changed.
next: Keep I167 focused on GTK2. Resume native scrollbar-state comparisons only when the separate MAME releases the guarded input path.
